Use Image3 for exact pose role/placement only and redraw the photographed NEW model from Images1/2. Original 1992 arcade cel cartoon, strong dark navy contours, broad clean flat shading. Generous transparent gutters and SINGLE connected silhouette per cell. No FX/glow/shadow, floor, grid, text, labels, background, extra people or detached limbs. True transparent PNG.
